notes: Single-stage with a dependent artifact: write a reusable merge tool, then run it on the visible fixtures to emit the conflict report. Medium reasoning: two-sided normalization (greatest synced_at wins, last-occurrence tie-break within an export), cross-export conflict detection (values differ AND both sources present), and a dated-precedence winner rule with payroll winning ties. Adversarial: malformed array elements, missing/non-string fields, unparseable exports, duplicate rows, solo/agreeing pairs, empty results. Verifier reruns the program on hidden export pairs and checks pairs_considered, total_conflicts == len(conflicts), ordering, entries layout, and winner/winner_export.
